name: Ocean Science Bowl
shortDescription: A buzzer competition on marine science — biology, chemistry, physical & earth science, and policy.

photos.alt: The team posing with trophies and stuffed-animal prizes after the Sea Lion Bowl
photos.caption: Sea Lion Bowl (NorCal)

overview: Ocean Science Bowl (the National Ocean Sciences Bowl's Sea Lion Bowl) is a buzzer competition covering marine biology, chemistry, physical science, geology, geography, history, technology, and policy. Each match pairs two buzzer rounds around a Team Challenge Question (TCQ) worksheet round, where the team works together on written questions; final scores combine TCQ and buzzer performance. Teams field four players plus one optional alternate. Regionals run in early February, with the top team advancing to Nationals in April–May; scrimmages run the month before Regionals.

participate.whoCanJoin: Open to any Mission San Jose High School student, grades 9–12.
participate.selectionProcess: General practices begin over the summer and continue until tryouts (date set each year).
participate.timeCommitment: Weekly practices through the season, plus scrimmages and the Regional/National tournaments.
participate.practiceSchedule: Currently online, Sundays 7–8 PM, with a planned move to in-person practices.
participate.whatToStudy: Buzzer training, scrimmages, and content review across marine biology, chemistry, physical/earth science, geography, history, technology, and policy — materials provided by Academic Challenge.

achievements.competition: Northern California Sea Lion Bowl Championship
